items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: we had, let's see, John, you see, was playing banjo with John Robeshoe. And then we had, sometimes Willie Paglia was to play trumpet.

ctx.x: Who was in that at that time?

Let's see, John Robeshoe Band, we had, let's see, now we had Old Man McCurtis, he's dead, Willie Humphrey, George Augustine on bass, Mercedes Goldman on piano, and we had, let's see, John, you see, was playing banjo with John Robeshoe. And then we had, sometimes Willie Paglia was to play trumpet. Uh-huh. And we had, uh, Charlie Love, John Robeshoe, himself on the band, on the violin, and Harrison Bones on trombone. Oh, yeah. I was on the drum, I'm thinking we played banjo, John, care banjo player sometimes. You…
